entries.title: I Chronicles 2:1
segments: ¶These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:2
segments: Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:3
segments: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah; these three were his sons by Bathshua, the Canaanite woman. And Er, Judah's oldest son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and he put him to death.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:4
segments: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had Perez and Zerah by him. All the sons of Judah were five.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:5
segments: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:6
segments: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri and Ethan and Heman and Calcol and Dara; five of them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:7
segments: And the sons of Carmi: Achan, the troubler of Israel, who did wrong about the cursed thing.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:8
segments: And the son of Ethan: Azariah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:9
segments: And the sons of Hezron, the offspring of his body: Jerahmeel and Ram and Chelubai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:10
segments: And Ram was the father of Amminadab; and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, chief of the children of Judah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:11
segments: And Nahshon was the father of Salma, and Salma was the father of Boaz,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:12
segments: And Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:13
segments: And Jesse was the father of Eliab, his oldest son, and Abinadab, the second, and Shimea, the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:14
segments: Nethanel, the fourth, Raddai, the fifth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:15
segments: Ozem, the sixth, David, the seventh;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:16
segments: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai and Joab and Asahel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:17
segments: And Abigail was the mother of Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:18
segments: ¶And Caleb, the son of Hezron, had children by Azubah his wife, the daughter of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher and Shobab and Ardon.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:19
segments: And after the death of Azubah, Caleb took as his wife Ephrath, who was the mother of Hur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:20
segments: And Hur was the father of Uri; and Uri was the father of Bezalel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:21
segments: And after that, Hezron had connection with the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, whom he took as his wife when he was sixty years old; and she had Segub by him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:22
segments: And Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:23
segments: And Geshur and Aram took the tent-towns of Jair from them, with Kenath and the small places round it, even sixty towns. All these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:24
segments: And after the death of Hezron, Caleb had connection with Ephrath, his father Hezron's wife, and she gave birth to his son Asshur, the father of Tekoa.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:25
segments: And the sons of Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, were Ram, the oldest, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem and Ahijah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:26
segments: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah: she was the mother of Onam.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:27
segments: And the sons of Ram, the oldest son of Jerahmeel, were Maaz and Jamin and Eker.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:28
segments: And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:29
segments: And the name of Abishur's wife was Abihail; and she had Ahban and Molid by him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:30
segments: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled came to his end without sons.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:31
segments: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:32
segments: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether came to his end without sons.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:33
segments: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:34
segments: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:35
segments: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, his servant, as a wife; and she had Attai by him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:36
segments: And Attai was the father of Nathan, and Nathan was the father of Zabad,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:37
segments: And Zabad was the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal was the father of Obed,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:38
segments: And Obed was the father of Jehu, and Jehu was the father of Azariah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:39
segments: And Azariah was the father of Helez, and Helez was the father of Eleasah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:40
segments: And Eleasah was the father of Sismai, and Sismai was the father of Shallum,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:41
segments: And Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:42
segments: And the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mareshah, his oldest son, who was the father of Ziph and Hebron.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:43
segments: And the sons of Hebron: Korah and Tappuah and Rekem and Shema.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:44
segments: And Shema was the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:45
segments: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:46
segments: And Ephah, Caleb's servant-wife, had Haran and Moza and Gazez; and Haran was the father of Gazez.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:47
segments: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:48
segments: Maacah, Caleb's servant-wife, was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:49
segments: And Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, Sheva, the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and Caleb's daughter was Achsah. These were the sons of Caleb.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:50
segments: The sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah; Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:51
segments: Salma, the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:52
segments: And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:53
segments: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:54
segments: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-Joab and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:55
segments: And the families of scribes who were living at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites, the offspring of Hammath, the father of the family of Rechab.
